chunks: If you do not, then take notice of a war from God and His Apostle. And if you repent, you shall have your principal sums. You will not oppress and you will not be oppressed.

key_terms.وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ: And you will not be oppressed

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not paying debts or complying with God's command regarding wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *ribā* (usury) and serves as a divine ultimatum for debtors to settle their obligations, emphasizing that the principal amount remains inviolable upon repentance. It underscores the principle of *adl* (justice), ensuring that neither the creditor loses their capital nor the debtor is burdened with unjust penalties, reflecting the broader Quranic prohibition of exploitative financial practices.
